raw_data_policy: Raw CSV, command lines and engine logs remain in private Saved storage. Four full numeric timelines retain each captured frame once; all window/phase reports reference their exact frame-index selections and the full CSV hash.

ambient_application.status: explicitly opted-in existing idle interactive Blender preserved
ambient_application.argument_policy: Executable only; no background, Python, file or other command-line arguments
limitations: An existing unsaved Blender GUI remained open and untouched during these C03 captures.
CPU is cumulative process time divided by wall time, expressed relative to one logical CPU, not whole-machine utilization.
Before/after scenario accounting covers launch and shutdown as well as profiling; it is not a continuous monitor and cannot exclude brief activity bursts.
Busy interval or changed process identity rejects that run and prevents the next scenario. No ambient process is closed or minimized.
C02 baseline ambient-process CPU was not recorded this way; identical baseline ambient CPU activity is not claimed.
